parsed.explanation: The write-up proves only that g has at most one positive value. It never proves g(t)≥0. From (3), induction gives f^n(t)=t+n g(t) for every n≥0; since every iterate must remain positive, g(t)<0 is impossible. This missing sentence is necessary before concluding V⊆{0,c} and proceeding with the level-set argument.
